message: The external lead delegates the bounded profile recovery described in profile-recovery-brief.md in this initiative. Read that brief and applicable guidance, verify your real managed identity, and acknowledge pickup. The live workspace daemon still reports the Rust rewrite thread active; the external app thread read was stale. Do not interrupt or message it. Use a fresh verification utility to wait read-only for the live idle check, then perform only the exact supported original-attempt recovery. Preserve owner, claim, candidate and approval. No new jobs, source edits, merge or state edits. External lead supervises and owns final acceptance. Save recovery logs/result and your acknowledged pickup in native-profile-recovery-pickup.json.
